correctness.rationale: The bundled verifier reconstructs the dodecahedral graph and the complete unordered two-particle discrete cubical complex with 190, 540, and 375 cells. The one-skeleton is connected, so rank d1 is 189. A 36-vector integral kernel certificate gives rank d2 at most 339, while exact GF(2) bitset elimination gives rank at least 339, hence rational rank exactly 339 and Betti numbers (1,12,36). The verifier enumerates all 120 graph automorphisms, computes signed cellular traces, reads exact H2 traces from the normalized integral cycle basis, obtains H1 traces by Lefschetz, and checks the stated A5 character decompositions. The finite computation proves only this finite graph case; no family extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral graph is a canonical 3-connected planar graph with the full symmetry group A5 by C2, and graph-configuration homology is explicitly functorial under graph automorphisms. Determining the complete H1 and H2 symmetry modules refines rank-only information into reusable equivariant data and directly complements structural work on planar graph braid homology. The object and symmetry are canonical rather than an arbitrary parameter slice, and the answer distinguishes the central-involution eigenspaces and the rational A5 constituents.
